title: fix(platform-objects): enabling two-factor and copying an invitation link are human-only identity actions
body:

_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNx?thread=cmsg_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNxA5aNWp4A2SV4FZHR1jhLti)_
Fixes #28368

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

domain:server#4 · os-zhuang · os-dev for claim 6541181717 · Ruling-ref: 6540309323 (#27900, 「其他同意」)
Tier: H (`docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md`): a contract review, then an authorised approval by a GOVERNED_APPROVER, before the queue.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两个 `enable_two_factor` 动作(`sys_user` 与 `sys_two_factor`)删掉 `ai` 块，从 E 档移到 H 档;`sys_invitation.copy_invitation_link` 评为 H 档，保持不写 `ai` 块。ADR-0011 附记更新三档名单(H23 / C17 / E19,共 36 个 `ai` 块、59 个动作)，并加一行:`sys_approval_request` 的 9 个动作未评估，评估前一律仅限人工。
- 为什么改：执行您在 #27900 上的裁决「其他同意」。启用双因素要用户密码、返回新的登录因子;邀请链接本身就是凭据。两者都不该让 agent 拿到。
- 风险与回滚：只收窄 agent 能看到的动作，Console 里登录用户的操作不变。回滚即还原这一个提交。
- 先看:`docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md` 的修订注记与名单;`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts` 的 `enable_two_factor`。
- 两分钟验证:`grep -c "ai: {" packages/platform-objects/src/identity/*.object.ts` 合计应为 36,且 `enable_two_factor` 下不再有 `ai:`。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 触及 ADR(Tier H),合同复审通过后需 os-zhuang 或 hotlong 批准。

## What changes

- **`sys_user.enable_two_factor`, `sys_two_factor.enable_two_factor` (E → H).** Each drops its `ai: { exposed: true, description }` block; a one-line comment names bucket H in its place. Over MCP neither is listed any more, and `run_action` refuses both by name (the existing per-action opt-in, `systemObjectActionExposureError`). A signed-in person runs both exactly as before.
- **`sys_invitation.copy_invitation_link` (assessed H).** No `ai` block, as before; a one-line comment names bucket H and why (the accept link is a bearer credential). No behaviour change.
- **ADR-0011, the 2026-10-30 identity addendum.** A dated amendment note (ruling of record 6540309323), the H list gains the three names (23), the E list loses two (19), the count paragraph reads 59 actions / 36 `ai` blocks, the "Not assessed" paragraph now records `sys_approval_request`'s 9 actions as unassessed and human-only, and the two "38 / 37" counts in the MCP paragraphs read 36 / 35.
- **Changesets.** New `28368-identity-two-factor-invite-link-human-only.md` (`@objectstack/platform-objects` patch). The unreleased `27900-identity-actions-ai-exposure.md` is corrected to the final lists (19 / 17 / 23, 59 assessed, 36 declared) so the release does not ship a sentence saying two-factor enabling is exposed.

### Reading of the card's item 1

The card says `copy_invitation_link` "gets an `ai` block, tier H". The ruling of record (6540309323) says "→ H (human-only)", the ADR's H row says "no `ai` block", and the ruled total, 36 `ai` blocks = C17 + E19, leaves no room for a 37th. So H here means no `ai` block; the action keeps today's declaration, and the change is its entry in the H list plus the code comment.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: 104 files, 1474 / 1474 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck`: exit 0.
- Build of the dependency closure (`pnpm --filter '@objectstack/platform-objects...' build`): exit 0.
- `git grep` of `enable_two_factor` and `copy_invitation_link` across `packages/runtime`, `packages/qa`, `packages/services` and `content/docs` found no test or doc pinning either action as agent-exposed. #28270 added no per-tier name-list pin (the maintainer struck the automatic check), so no pin moves.

## Acceptance notes

- **`Metadata-protocol: none`.** The claim first read `narrowed`; the seat amended it to `none`, since the kind is defined by what a metadata author can write and these are values on an existing key of platform-owned metadata (the same kind #28270 declared). So the changeset is `patch` and carries no ADR-0087 marker.
- **`check-empty-changeset` is red on purpose.** This PR corrects the still-unreleased `.changeset/27900-identity-actions-ai-exposure.md` (#28270's note) to the final lists: exposed 19 (enabling two-factor removed), human-only 23 (enabling two-factor and copying an invitation link added), 59 assessed / 36 declared. Without it, the release would ship a sentence saying enabling two-factor is agent-exposed. The gate puts this DELIBERATE CORRECTION in front of a person by staying red; please confirm it at landing.
- The ruling also asked for one note line on `sys_approval_request`; its 9 actions (`plugin-approvals`) were measured to declare no `ai` block, so the note matches the code.
